cells.gaps: The DHIS2-based EMIS is a pilot only: four schools in Machinga and Dedza in May 2026 (MWI-009) and the two districts in July 2026 (MWI-007), with no level named (read as primary) and no school past the pilot. It is launched by the Unlocking Data Initiative with HISP-UNIMA, with no ministry owner, plan or budget stated. How the record is kept disagrees: routine attendance entry in the pilot (MWI-006, July 2026) against paper registers in cohort tracking elsewhere (MWI-004, May 2026). MWI-001 to MWI-003 are from the excluded source and set nothing.
cells.note: A DHIS2 system with learner attendance, enrolment and transfer modules is being piloted in schools in Dedza and Machinga in 2026, which is stage 2. Stage 3 needs it past its pilot and live in primary schools, and no row says so.
